about: Seconds per test file of the fast suite (pytest -m 'not slow') on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner. Input to .github/ci/ci_shards.py; regenerate with its 'durations' command from the shard reports of a green run on main.
source: CI run 38773487899, job 116555067461 (tests (py3.11), commit 75195ed2, 2026-10-15, unsharded, 2860.9 s of which 52 s collection). Each -q progress line's timestamp delta split over its 72 tests in proportion to a local junit run of the same suite.
